name: Huabao Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Huabao Technology Co., Ltd. engages in research and development, production, sale, and service of flavors and food ingredients to the food, beverages, tobacco, and daily chemicals industries in China and internationally. It operates through three divisions: Food Flavors, Daily Fragrance, and Food Ingredients. The company offers products in the fields of sweet flavoring and savory flavoring that are used in used in dairy products, beverages, frozen drinks, candies, nuts and seeds, puffed food, baking, meat products, and snack food.
